summary: Default Linux worker-ingress generation checks to observation and require explicit per-daemon enforcement opt-in.

replay.detail: No claim format or replay change.

compatibility.detail: The optional top-level daemon key worker_ingress_generation_check accepts observe or enforce; absent means observe. Observe logs worker authority observation would refuse without refusing requests. Unknown values are startup configuration errors. macOS remains unverified-platform with existing admission.

downtime.detail: Restart the daemon to apply a mode change. Deploy observe first, review at least 24 hours of journal evidence, then opt members into enforce one at a time.

manual.detail: Set worker_ingress_generation_check = "enforce" only after reviewing worker-only route observations, including worker restarts. Until then the unbound local caller authority gap remains open.

recovery.detail: Set observe and restart the daemon to return to logging without enforcement; no data migration is needed.
